title: Under the counting house
lines: dm
The vault door under the Counting House on Marrow Street is covered in frost.
a
Isolde presses her hand to the door and feels it hum.
b
Garrick reads the runes aloud and says they warn of a curse.
dm
The frost spreads across Isolde's glove and she loses feeling in two fingers.
a
Isolde pulls back and takes four points of cold damage.
b
Garrick burns a scroll of warding against the door.
dm
The hum fades and the door swings open on a room of stacked coins.
a
Isolde takes a single gold ring from the top of a pile.
dm
Behind them the door begins to close, and something scrapes in the dark.
b
Garrick drags Isolde out just as the door shuts with a boom.
dm
The street is silent. The ring is cold, and it is whispering.
